h1: St. Anton am Arlberg ski resort, stays & events guide
heroText: St. Anton sits at 1,304 metres on the Ski Arlberg network, which the operator calls Austria's largest ski resort: 301 kilometres of slopes and 85 lifts, reaching 2,811 metres at Valluga's peak. More than 200 kilometres of the terrain is marked as powder descent rather than piste, and nine metres of natural snow falls in an average season.
stayOverview: The village centre is at the Galzig base station; Nasserein at the eastern end has its own gondola and fewer bars; St. Christoph sits up at the pass at 1,793 m for the snow rather than the nightlife.
hotelIntro: Book against high season. All four villages on this page are on one Ski Arlberg pass, so the choice is about the walk to the lift and the noise at night.
rentalCars: St. Anton is on the Arlberg railway with its own station, so this is one of the few major Alpine resorts you can reach without a car.
